claim_boundary: This contract source-binds pure-liquid macroscopic state anchors to an exact molecular-model digest. It is not a molecular direct-correlation asset, a liquid free-energy functional, a total solvation calculation, a force/PES result, an accuracy result, or a way to infer an absent solvent from a dielectric constant.

construction.model_binding: Every state record hash-binds its values to one exact all-atom molecular-model source. A state record for one charge/Lennard-Jones/geometry model cannot be reused for another model.
construction.macroscopic_state: The source records temperature, pressure, molecular number density, static and optical dielectric limits, isothermal compressibility, and surface tension. Every field carries its own HTTPS, content-addressed source locator and an origin restricted to independent measurement, ab initio calculation, or upstream-model validation.
construction.zero_mode_constraint: For a one-component number channel, S_NN(0) = rho k_B T kappa_T = [1-rho c_NN(0)]^-1. The implementation exposes this one zero-mode consequence only; it does not promote c_NN(0) to a molecular site-site C_ab(k).
construction.finite_k_nonidentifiability: A real reciprocal perturbation delta C_ab(k)=t A_ab k^2 exp[-(k ell)^2] leaves k=0 constraints unchanged. For a stable baseline and sufficiently small t it changes finite-k solvent response while retaining the scalar state anchors. Therefore the source is insufficient by construction for cavity, dispersion, orientational structure, or total solvation.

required_before_molecular_liquid_or_tota: one content-addressed source-only bulk-state record matching the exact molecular model
a frozen all-atom molecular site model and canonical rigid geometry
a source-provenanced finite-k molecular susceptibility/direct-correlation matrix or declared molecular liquid functional
a frozen solvent-side short-range and dispersion interaction compatible with the same liquid scalar
a source-bound bridge/kernel/planar-interface certificate when the weighted-density bridge is used
one common stationary liquid free-energy, standard-state, force, and production grid/orientation contract

current_inventory.decision: No physical bulk-state source record is checked in. The two all-atom molecular records remain below liquid-asset admission and cannot be combined with guessed density, dielectric, compressibility, surface tension, closure, or finite-k correlation data.

validation_sequence: Validate strict per-property provenance, exact molecular-model digest binding, physical units and limits, and explicit false no-target/no-training policy.

When a RISM input exists, cross-check exactly its temperature, molecular number density, and static dielectric against the source record; retain pressure, optical dielectric, compressibility, and surface-tension provenance separately.
Require a finite-k correlation/liquid-functional asset independently; do not reconstruct it from scalar state values or from the one-component compressibility zero mode.
Only after all molecular-liquid, bridge, common-scalar, force, standard-state, grid/orientation, 11-solvent, and blind-validation gates pass may a total-free-energy claim be evaluated.
decision_rule: A missing state field, source digest, model binding, RISM-state mismatch, finite-k liquid asset, or later structural/accuracy gate rejects the candidate. It does not authorize a guessed property, a proxy solvent, post-training, fine-tuning, solvation-label fitting, MAP/UQ calibration, response modification, or per-record model choice.
